title: centaurium littorale var. turneri
intro: Centaurium littorale var. turneri, commonly known as Mountain Centaury, is a subspecies of the Centaurium littorale plant, which belongs to the Gentianaceae family. It is a herbaceous perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Centaurium littorale var. turneri include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties.
